chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ:

translations.en: He said: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Indeed, when the soul secures its provision, it becomes settled."

en.summary: This hadith teaches that the human soul finds calm and stability when its necessary sustenance is secured. It points to the importance of obtaining basic provision in creating inner settledness and peace.
en.seo_question: How does securing one's basic provision affect the state of the soul in hadith?
